title: UK Regulatory Monitor
subtitle: FCA · PRA · ICO · CMA · FRC — enforcement, guidance, and rulemaking
schedule_note: Updated every 6 hours via GitHub Actions

items.title: PRA fines HDI Global SE £4,165,000 for inaccurate reporting of FSCS Liabilities and FSCS Fee Tariff data
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has imposed a financial penalty of £4,165,000 on HDI Global SE in connection with the submission of incorrect data to the PRA.

items.title: UK financial regulators to begin overseeing Critical Third Parties announced by HM Treasury
items.summary: The Bank of England, the Prudential Regulation Authority and the Financial Conduct Authority will start overseeing the first Critical Third Parties on Monday 13 July 2026, following designation by HM Treasury.

items.title: FCA and partners continues crackdown on illegal crypto trading
items.summary:
The FCA and partners have taken further action against illegal peer-to-peer crypto trading in London.

The FCA has carried out further operations with partners to disrupt illegal peer-to-peer crypto trading across multiple London locations.

items.title: Financial regulator bans former law firm owner from financial services
items.summary: The FCA has banned Nurul Miah, also known as Neil Mia and Neil Miah, from working in financial services.

items.title: Upper Tribunal upholds Crispin Odey ban
items.summary:
Crispin Odey’s ban from the financial services industry has been upheld by the Upper Tribunal, which found he lacked integrity.

Mr Odey was the founder and majority owner of Odey Asset Management (OAM).

items.title: Young investors trust AI more than TV or celebrities
items.summary: Four in 5 less experienced investors have used AI for help with investing – and around two-thirds report doing so occasionally or regularly.

items.title: PRA sets out adjustments to its market risk internal model approach under Basel 3.1
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has today published a consultation on the internal model approach to market risk (IMA), which represents the final piece of Basel 3.1’s implementation in the UK.

items.title: FCA and partners join forces to help improve financial security for millions
items.summary:
The FCA is partnering across sectors to expand protection insurance coverage for millions of unprotected people.

While the market is working well for consumers who have protection insurance, millions of people remain unprotected.

items.title: Crypto firms get guidance on how the new regime applies
items.summary:
New FCA guidance will help firms understand how the law underpinning the UK's future cryptoasset regime applies to their business. It also sets out which activities may require FCA authorisation.

The regime comes into force on 25 October 2027.

items.title: Financial crime: protecting the hive
items.summary:
Speech by Steve Smart, executive director of enforcement and market oversight, at the Law Society Economic Crime Conference 2026.

IntroductionA few weeks ago, I visited the Bank of England Museum to see a new exhibition on financial crime.

items.title: FCA opens investigation into Euro Exchange Securities UK Ltd
items.summary:

items.title: FCA urges young adults to check for unclaimed Child Trust Funds
items.summary: Thousands of young adults could be sitting on a forgotten pot of savings as they head back to college and university.

items.title: Man pleads guilty to fraud and forgery offences relating to fake takeover approach
items.summary: Christopher Woolcott has pleaded guilty to 4 counts of fraud and forgery after creating a fake takeover bid for Touchstone Exploration Inc.

items.title: Trainline, Virgin Atlantic and RED Driving School investigated for drip pricing
items.summary: Investigations into online pricing practices are part of CMA’s work to help ease cost of living pressures.

items.title: CMA letter to PHIN welcoming achievement of gold compliance milestone
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) welcomes the achievement by the Private Healthcare Information Network (PHIN) and the private healthcare industry of the ‘gold milestone’ of full compliance with the CMA’s Private …

items.title: Premier Payment Solutions Ltd enters liquidation
items.summary: On 10 September 2026, Premier Payment Solutions Ltd, which traded as PPS Money and MTBS (together, 'PPS Money'), entered liquidation. Bai Cham and Gary Shankland of BTG Begbies Traynor were appointed joint liquidators.

items.title: Bank of England launches policy statement and draft rules on regulating systemic stablecoins
items.summary: The Bank of England has today published its policy statement and draft Code of Practice (rules) for systemic stablecoin issuers.

items.title: Public procurement in the national interest: Reflections from the CMA
items.summary:
Opening remarks by Sarah Cardell, the CMA’s Chief Executive, delivered at the Parliamentary event with the Competition and Markets Authority,
Jubilee Room, House of Commons on 8 September 2026.

items.title: CMA secures compensation for heating oil customers
items.summary: Hundreds set to receive compensation after their orders were cancelled following the conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: Open letter to the private parking sector
items.summary: A letter issued by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) to private parking operators.

items.title: CMA letter to government in relation to private parking
items.summary: Letter sent by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) to the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.

items.title: FCA sets out steps to support small businesses' access to finance
items.summary:
Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) could access finance more easily after the FCA sets out practical steps to help.

An FCA review found no evidence that its regulation is a major barrier for SME access to finance.

items.title: FCA decides to ban and fine Daniel Thomas over unauthorised pension transfer advice
items.summary: The FCA has decided to ban Daniel Thomas from working in financial services and fine him £742,700 after finding he recklessly gave defined benefit pension transfer advice he was neither qualified nor allowed to give.

items.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
items.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.

items.title: PRA and FCA propose new captive insurance regime to drive UK growth and competitiveness
items.summary: Innovative new proposals aim to establish the UK as a centre for the fast-growing captive insurance market.

items.title: FCA takes Hunter Jones to High Court over alleged unauthorised activity
items.summary:
The FCA has begun High Court proceedings against Osborne Baldwin Limited, which trades as Hunter Jones and Hunter Jones Group.

The FCA alleges that Hunter Jones, which sells loan notes, carries out regulated activity without authorisation.

items.title: Vandemoortele required to sell UK plant following pastry merger investigation
items.summary: Clearance decision comes well ahead of deadline following constructive engagement by the businesses with the CMA’s inquiry group.

items.title: CMA investigates Microsoft over marketing of subscription plans
items.summary: Investigation will examine whether customers were misled about Microsoft 365 subscription options and paid more as a result.

items.title: PRA consults on updated guidance for friendly society amalgamations and transfers
items.summary: The proposals would provide more detail on the PRA’s approach to Part VIII transactions, helping firms plan amalgamations and transfers more efficiently.

items.title: Statistical Notice 2026/07 -  Bank of England Levy: Notification Document Levy Year 2026/27
items.summary: Statistical Notices update the definitions and guidance contained in the Banking Statistics Yellow Folder
